en.title: Infamous 1983 NBC Flop Manimal Just Entered the Marvel Universe
en.summary: An unlikely TV crossover has officially cemented a forgotten 1980s series within the vast Marvel multiverse. This bizarre connection is set to be further explored in an upcoming Marvel project.
en.body:
In the annals of television history, some shows are remembered for their groundbreaking impact, while others… well, they’re remembered for other reasons. **Manimal**, an NBC series that aired for just eight episodes in 1983, falls firmly into the latter category. Its premise, about a wealthy man who could shapeshift into any animal, was certainly ambitious for its time. Yet, despite its short lifespan and critical reception, **Manimal** has achieved a peculiar form of immortality, officially entering the expansive Marvel Universe.

This remarkable feat wasn't achieved through a direct comic book tie-in or a superhero team-up in the traditional sense. Instead, **Manimal** technically crossed paths with the Marvel Multiverse via **Night Man**, a television adaptation of a Malibu Comics property that NBC also aired. This unexpected crossover, occurring in 1983, predates many of the Marvel Cinematic Universe's sprawling narratives, offering a fascinating glimpse into how interconnectedness could be established even in disparate television eras. The fact that a show as obscure as **Manimal** found its way into this shared fictional space is a testament to the creative possibilities and sometimes strange coincidences that occur within the world of television adaptations.

## A Multiverse Connection Unveiled

The integration of **Manimal** into the Marvel Universe was further solidified and expanded upon by Marvel Studios themselves. In 2026, Marvel's popular animated series **What If...?**, which explores alternate timelines and realities within the Marvel Multiverse, is set to feature **Manimal**. This deliberate inclusion by Marvel Television leadership, specifically Brad Winderbaum, confirms that **Manimal** is now officially a part of Marvel's ever-growing multiverse. It’s a surprising twist for a series that many might have considered lost to the dustbin of television flops, now finding a new life and a significant place within one of the most dominant entertainment franchises in the world.

## Why This Matters to Fans

For dedicated fans of both Marvel and the often-quirky landscape of television history, this news is a delightful Easter egg. It speaks to a deeper appreciation for the history of comic book adaptations and the potential for unexpected narrative connections. The **What If...?** series thrives on exploring these 'what if' scenarios, and incorporating a show like **Manimal** offers a unique angle that fans will undoubtedly dissect and debate. It’s a nod to the past that enriches the present, proving that no story, no matter how short-lived, is entirely disconnected in the grand tapestry of fictional universes.

## What's Next

Fans can anticipate seeing how **Manimal** is integrated into the Marvel Multiverse when the new season of **What If...?** premieres in 2026. Details on the specific episode or how **Manimal** will be portrayed are still emerging, but its official inclusion is confirmed.

content_raw: In 1983, an NBC series technically entered the Marvel Universe via a crossover with Night Man, which was a TV adaptation of a Malibu Comics property.
